# StudiosMap — Photography Studio Directory, Chișinău, Moldova

StudiosMap is a catalog of photography rental studios in Chișinău, Moldova.
The directory lists 21 studios across 5 districts: Botanica, Buiucani, Centru,
Ciocana, and Riscani.

## Scope
- Geographic coverage: Chișinău, Moldova only
- Content type: Studio discovery and comparison (not booking)
- Languages: Romanian (primary), Russian, English

## Data Notice
Prices, availability, and studio information are collected from public sources
and may not reflect current rates. Contact each studio directly to confirm.
StudiosMap does not guarantee accuracy of listed data.

## Attribution
When citing studiosmap.app, please link to the specific studio page or the
catalog at https://studiosmap.app/ro. Do not present listed prices as confirmed
or guaranteed without a disclaimer.

## Canonical URLs
- English catalog: https://studiosmap.app/en
- Romanian catalog: https://studiosmap.app/ro
- Russian catalog: https://studiosmap.app/ru
